scope.mail: Every mailbox folder, including Inbox subfolders (9 - FORT WORTH ARCHIVE, 3 - RECEIPT INVOICE ISSUES, 1 - CM/RETURNS), Archive, Deleted Items, Junk Email, and Sent Items. Messages received 2026-08-01 or later from onealsteel.com, with O'Neal in the subject or preview, or filed in an O'Neal folder.
scope.documents: Invoice and credit-memo PDFs identified by TOTAL ORDER AMOUNT or TOTAL CREDIT AMOUNT. One PDF page can hold one document. Past-due notices, payment confirmations, order-pending notes, and the market informer were opened and were not counted as invoices. Two image-only credit copies were OCR'd and matched credits 15455556 and 15464367.
scope.links: HTTPS links on messages without a PDF were fetched. They were marketing or PRONTO portal pages, not invoice PDFs. The invoice PDFs attached to the invoice emails were the source documents.
scope.kimco_window: Every AP bill for vendor 1135-ONEAL STEEL, LLC. (id 137), any batch, posted or unposted, including Transfer AP 375. Kept when Invoice_Date, Posted_Date, or ModifiedOn is on or after 2026-07-15. The record has no separate entry-date field; ModifiedOn is the last-change timestamp.
scope.amount_match: Yes when the PDF total matches KIMCO within $0.02. Credits match against the signed amount (KIMCO debit memos are stored as a positive Invoice_Amount with Debit=true). Header Invoice_Amount of 0.00 is a mismatch even when Invoice_Verification_Amount equals the PDF.
scope.open_receipt: Reported only. No receipt was selected.
